premises.text: Lab-centric milk testing is slow, labor-intensive, error-prone, and typically only monthly, so farmers lack real-time herd health information
premises.evidence_span: this lab-centric testing is time-consuming, labor-intensive, and often prone to human errors. So lack of real-time information is causing a big problem for industry. Today, dairy farmers only offer testing once a month

premises.text: Mastitis is hard to detect early, spreads easily, and is the most common expensive dairy disease, requiring frequent early testing
premises.evidence_span: Mastitis is hard to detect, unlike COVID, and spreads easily among the herd. To stop it, you need to test often and test early

premises.text: Optical milk analyzer with embedded ML captures reagent-free optical data and returns quality metrics (butterfat, protein, SCC) in ~10 seconds
premises.evidence_span: optical milk analyzer with embedded machine learning. Second, a portal with customized data visual for milk quality and health management. Finally, a remote veterinary support from our animal care partners

premises.text: Portal/dashboard provides herd and cow-level continuous milk quality and health monitoring
premises.evidence_span: Our dashboard provide. milk quality information on both herd level and individual cow level. With our daily, weekly, and monthly data, farmer now have reliable and continuous data to monitor the health of their herd

premises.text: Remote veterinary support from animal-care partners supplies best practices and recommendations
premises.evidence_span: a remote veterinary support from our animal care partners for best practices and recommendations

premises.text: Solution scales across producers, co-ops, and processors as reagent-free, low-maintenance, no-special-training testing
premises.evidence_span: our solution can be easily scale up entire supply chain from dairy producers, to dairy co-op and dairy processors. Enormously reduce the length and the difficulty of testing process. Compared to traditional lab-based testing, our technology is reagent-free, low-maintenance, and requires no special training
